title: REST API
simpleMetaphor: Standard HTTP requests (GET, POST) delivering formatted JSON responses.
technicalExplanation: Resource-based API architectural style using standard HTTP protocols and JSON payloads.

title: GraphQL
simpleMetaphor: Request exact fields in a single query instead of hitting multiple API endpoints.
technicalExplanation: Query language and server runtime that allows clients to specify exact data shapes.

title: gRPC
simpleMetaphor: High-speed binary communication protocol for backend microservices.
technicalExplanation: High-performance Remote Procedure Call framework using Protocol Buffers over HTTP/2.

title: WebSockets
simpleMetaphor: Persistent open connection for instant, real-time live chat or updates.
technicalExplanation: Bi-directional, full-duplex communication channel over a single TCP socket.

title: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
simpleMetaphor: One-way stream from server to client, perfect for live AI responses or stock tickers.
technicalExplanation: Standard HTTP interface enabling servers to push real-time text updates to client browsers.

title: Webhooks
simpleMetaphor: Automated notification sent from one server to another when an event happens.
technicalExplanation: Event-driven HTTP POST callbacks triggered by external services (e.g., Stripe payments).

title: tRPC
simpleMetaphor: Typesafe API bridge between frontend and backend without writing manual schemas.
technicalExplanation: End-to-end typesafe API layer taking advantage of TypeScript type inference.
